analyze: The script successfully performed dimensionality reduction and clustering on the single-cell RNA-seq data. It completed all required steps including reading the preprocessed data, computing PCA with 50 components, building a neighborhood graph with 15 neighbors and 30 PCs, running UMAP dimensionality reduction, performing Leiden clustering with resolution 0.5, and saving both the processed data as h5ad and visualization as PDF. All packages were already installed in the environment, and the script executed without any errors, generating the expected output files. The data contained 1000 cells and 33541 genes which were properly processed through the entire workflow.
